definitions.gloss: iron fist; hard punch; a blow with a clenched fist
definitions.explanation: Literally 'iron fist'. Refers to a powerful punch or blow with the fist.

examples.japanese: {鉄拳|てっけん}⟦{制裁|せいさい}→制裁：11846_seisai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{加|くわ}える→加える：01941_kuwaeru⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{相手|あいて}→相手：01677_aite⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{鉄拳|てっけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見舞|みま}った→見舞う：14133_mimau⟧。
examples.english: He landed a hard punch on his opponent.

examples.japanese: ⟦かつて→かつて：10303_katsute⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{体罰|たいばつ}→体罰：11568_taibatsu⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧{鉄拳|てっけん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{用|もち}いられる→用いる：02314_mochiiru⟧こと⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{許容|きょよう}→許容：14172_kyoyou⟧⟦されない→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: In the past, physical punishment with the fist was sometimes used, but it is no longer acceptable today.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{鉄|てつ}→鉄：02225_tetsu⟧ (iron) + {拳|けん} (fist). Used mainly literally, for a hard punch, especially in {鉄拳|てっけん}⟦{制裁|せいさい}→制裁：11846_seisai⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {鉄拳|てっけん}⟦{制裁|せいさい}→制裁：11846_seisai⟧: iron-fisted punishment; a blow as punishment
- {鉄拳|てっけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{振|ふ}るう→振るう：12793_furuu⟧: to swing an iron fist; to use force
- {鉄拳|てっけん}⟦{制裁|せいさい}→制裁：11846_seisai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{食|く}らう: to receive a punch as punishment

NOTE: {鉄拳|てっけん}⟦{制裁|せいさい}→制裁：11846_seisai⟧ is the most common fixed compound — physical punishment as a form of discipline, now generally considered unacceptable.
